walk 9 dressing (dressing.md § 4, water village): the crews-house's trade gets a market stall on the crews path; the islet dries the catch on a fish rack north of the islet path, where the long walk lands. Both stand on their own small pads, sited by `wb.py scan` on dry ground.

walk 11 part 5a: yard dressing restored round the plank shells, every piece on a `wb.py site --free --clear 0.7` cell. Crews' work yard on the dry strip behind and east of the crews' house (rain barrel at the corner, stores, a seat, a wash line on the north side); the crews' net and bucket west of the door; the family yard round the family door (a candle within 2 m of it, a seat and firewood east of it, baskets north of the house and by the market stall), a bucket, a sack and an urn by the shrine totem.

walk 12 wave 2: breadth M1 (p50 dressing within 12 m of a dwelling 18 < 20): two pieces by the crews' house, one by the family door, on `wb.py site --free --clear 0.5` cells.

16x riverwalk: the plank houses front the water (97 C8); each door is met by a bound landing of laid boards (the Kothringi plank boards of the plank kit, mended odd lengths), never by a path laid to the sill (doorFrontRule). Crews: the door keeps its yaw (it looks out at 230 deg to the cove); six boards before it on the pad, the crews path re-laid to start off their outer edge.

16x riverwalk: the plank houses front the water (97 C8); each door is met by a bound landing of laid boards (the Kothringi plank boards of the plank kit, mended odd lengths), never by a path laid to the sill (doorFrontRule). Family: turned 180 to face the cove (the other reading, the back yard to the north, was not taken: the yard stays a work yard behind the house); eight boards across the porch's front and a ninth laid lengthwise as a tongue out to the long walk's head, the family path a short spur from them to the hut path; its pad dropped (a stilt shell takes none) and the house lifted 0.12 m so its posts stand in the bed, not past their length; its door lantern re-hung beside the new door.

floats on its seabed tether (ferry-raft class), its stage end 0.09 m off the landing end fs02 so a passenger steps aboard (owner call 18); no rigid plank or rider rests on it, so nothing has to stay put while it rides the tide
Moved 0.8 m clear of the stage-shelter wall and store; still under the shelter, facing the room.

Walk 12: the shovel and pitchfork stay standing on the ground against the shelf's dry face; both meshes are authored upright (1.5 m and 1.4 m tall) and an unmined mount refuses them on the slab (0102 decision 5), so the slab carries only the flat offerings.
Walk 12 (owner): bones, skulls and a ribcage strewn on the dry rim round the pool's north, east and south bank, the predator cue: what the wamasu leaves when it hauls out.
Walk 12 close-out: the bones close into a ring round the landing arc of the pool, west shore to east shallows; some lie in the shallows where the wamasu drops them.

Walk 12 close-out (R127): the pilgrim notice is carved on a 6.9 m grey Argonian obelisk, xanmeer stone like the old shrines, on the bank approach, so it is seen from afar; it hosts socket sign-carving.

The Wamasu Shrine: one Ayleid dressed block on the pond bank, loaded with salt, iron and a net; a shovel and a pitchfork given as offerings stood against its dry face; a painted offering urn beside it; five pebble tally marks along the bank; shed scales and a gnawed bone at the waterline; storm-scorched ash at the shelf's water end; a floor candle at each end.
Stands on the ground 0.3 m clear of the shelf. It does not lean on the shelf's side.
Stands on the ground 0.3 m clear of the shelf. It does not lean on the shelf's side.

2.9b: the slice's one enchanting table stands beside the shrine shelf of Haynekhtnamet, where the four villages lay their gifts; a supplicant binds a gift's power at the god's own stone. Clear of the shelf apron, the urn and the notice stone, with the stand spot to its north-west.
2.9b node.hanging-moss: blue moss hangs on the shaded wet bank by the somnalius fern, outside the shrine's worked ground (fauna-hazards.md:99).
2.9b node.hanging-moss host: a gnarled mangrove root arches over the wet bank and the blue moss hangs from its bough, the way it hangs from the swamp canopy across Black Marsh.
c7: re-seated 0.4 m west, turned to 120, so the whole stack sits on the shelf top between the salt piles; it overhung the south-east edge by 0.15 m.

c7 haul-out: the wamasu hauls out on the bank strip at the hunt idle (4740, 982); shed scales, a gnawed bone, a prey skull and a torn leg mark where it drags out, on the carriers' approach, so a visitor reads the danger before the shelf.

audit10 c5 wave 2: the 13 rocks02 touch only 0.4 m under the ground and showed 0.14-0.33 m gaps at it (blender/examples/ring_lip.py). Thirteen rocks03, each over a gap at 3.2 m from the centre, close the lip at the ground; the plugins place rocks03 touching rocks02 (kit-mounts-mined abuts 21), so their crossing is designed. rocks03 seats 0.95-1.05 m deep (bar 1.133) and shows about 0.5 m.

audit10 c5 P4: the spring lip is 13 rocks02 chained round sp-pool at 2.92 m from its centre (sp-ring3 at 2.97 m), each touching the next with no crossing (wb check gaps 0.002-0.031 m); the pool rim is 0.3 m so the lip stands on natural ground. No plugin in the pool places a ring, well or pool-edge set an Argonian village may use (kit-assemblies-mined: whiterun wrpondwall*, imperial mwimparchpool01, volcanic mineralpool* are off-culture or in no published kit)

walk 12 wave 2: the lodge's hanging sign (gs-sign) is removed. The lodge is a domed mud pod: every face the beam can meet reads roof-edge (faceNormalZ 0.82-0.95, R127). No post in the pool carries a mined pair for the blackwood board (its twin test against the Whiterun stables board misses by 0.011 m). The standing notice board d9-notice beside the lodge door is the lodge's service board.

walk 9 dressing (dressing.md § 4, Hist village): the village's dead lie under two low cairns north-west of the Hist and north of the spring-keeper's house (burial runs through the Hist: argonia-4e201-state.md:165-167); the east family keeps two hives on their bench and two hens' nests behind the hut; the family hut by the nets dries fish on a rack. Sites from `wb.py site --free --clear 0.7`.

walk 12 wave 2 (R132, open-way bar 0.75): the five bare 25 m stretches of the village paths each get a piece within 6 m. Sites from `wb.py site --clear 0.5 --nearest`. The path banks run 5-9 degrees, too steep for a set-down prop, so four stretches carry a dug-in marker pole beside the path (the dug-in fit stands on banked ground) and the stretch by the common a full basket.
2.9b-e3: the tree-minder steeps her healing draughts at a bench against her hut wall, facing the sick sleeping tree she tends; a healers' village brews from what grows on its own rootland floor.
2.9b-e3: node.rootland-mushroom. Tall rootland mushrooms grow in the damp shade among the sleeping tree's surface roots.
2.9b-e3: node.swamp-fungal-pod. Fungal pods swell on the wet rootland floor on the sleeping tree's shaded north side.

2.9b-p: node.nirnroot. Nirnroot is a very rare plant that grows near water (UESP Lore:Nirnroot; fauna-hazards.md:101 names it in Black Marsh's flora), so one stands on the natural ground just outside the spring's stone lip, 1.2 m from the fill rocks, on the side away from the spring house door.

walk 11 (bog-iron-3): the KotM plank house house1-with-door, the one enterable shell legal here whose linked cell (LilmothApothecaryHouse) passes the interior acceptance gate (the round huts' Root-Whisper cells need Creation Club meshes). It stands at its designed sink (mesh-sill 0.69 m) on a levelled pad, its sill 0.34 m over the pad, one step. Door faces east to the furnace floor. The lantern stands on the ground beside the door.

walk 12 (W2): the plank-house scale fix (A1 c1, shells at 1.3) made the hut 30% larger and the lamp stood inside its east wall; moved 1.5 m east onto open ground beside the door, the crew-stores group with it; the survey still found it 0.17 m inside the hut's pad/porch, the hut's base step reaches 1.7 m past the threshold, so the lamp stands ON the step (1990.6, 2533.3, 1.9 m from the threshold, inside the 2 m entrance-light limit): mounted inside on the hut's first surface, then lifted 0.19 m because the lantern's foot sat 0.18 m into the step (measured; check green).

walk 11 (bog-iron-4): the charcoal bed, a flat heap of coal raked out before the furnace mouth, laid against the stone apron on the mouth side (the dome stands at about 2009.5, 2539.2; its apron runs 2541-2544). The same mesh vanilla lays as smelter01coal01. Its sink is a reviewed assetPlacement row (sink 0, floor plane at the pivot).
walk 12 (W2, owner): stacked iron bars by the smelter, the season's worked bloom drawn out into bars on the furnace floor west of the dome, where the road crews collect them.

The dig at the seep's south edge: a shovel stuck in the mud (its plugin sinks it 0.54 m, as vanilla stands shovels in dirt mounds), the ore cakes lifted out heaped beside it, a bucket of cakes and a full basket to carry up to the furnace.
Duckboards: loose planks laid crosswise over the wet margin from the cart to the water's-edge pit, as the Kothringi lay them over mud.
2.5x seats: a rough farm bench beside the diggers' cook fire, where the season's crew sit to eat at midday between charges of the furnace; sited by es.site on flat ground, off the furnace path.
2.5x seats: a rough farm bench beside the diggers' cook fire, where the season's crew sit to eat at midday between charges of the furnace; sited by es.site on flat ground, off the furnace path.

2.9b: The crew's smithy corner at the west edge of the furnace floor: the bloom drawn from the smelter is reheated and worked here into the nails, tyres and tools that wear out fast on the road (places-imperial-fringe.json:259).
2.9b: The anvil stands at the forge's east mouth, about 2.4 m from the hearth, so the smith turns from fire to anvil in one step with the hot bloom in the tongs.
2.9b: The crew's bench for hafting and fitting tools, a step behind the anvil on the forge's north-east, laid along the hearth's ring so hearth, anvil and bench are worked without walking.
2.9b: The grindstone on the anvil's side of the forge, to the south-east, on the last flat ground before the bellows, where the diggers put an edge back on their spades and blades.

2.9b: Somnalius fern grows on the damp ground below the furnace floor beside the other ferns; a forager cuts a frond and it grows back (fauna-hazards.md:98). Gather node node.somnalius-fern (the runtime binds a placed somnalius-fern species piece by asset, gather.ts nodeIdOfAsset).

2.9b: Marshweed tufts at the seep's water edge past the diggings; the crew smoke it of an evening (fauna-hazards.md:99). Gather node node.marshweed (the runtime binds a placed marshweed species piece by asset, gather.ts nodeIdOfAsset).

walk 9 dressing (dressing.md § 4, road station): a travellers' table and its bench beside the well, east of the station house; a chopping block at the station-house woodpile; a hide rack in the stable yard. Every site is dry and level ground chosen by `wb.py scan` or `wb.py site`.

2.9b-e: the alchemy table stands under the station house eaves on its yard side, its back to the long wall, 1.3 m clear in front and the yard wall 3 m behind the user; the house interior is a plugin cell (no additions), so the keeper's apparatus works outside the door where lodgers buy remedies.
2.9b-e: mountain flower beside the well; its dried buds purify ground water (material-culture.md:153), so the keeper grows it at the well head.
2.9b-e: marshweed at the tarn bank 0.1 m above the water line; it grows in tufts at the water's edge (fauna-hazards.md:99).

The Tag House is an open HTBM half pavilion on posts, with no levelled pad. It is the handover shelter. Its front faces north onto two ways that end at its two front corners. The arrival half (west, toward the Rose) has closed baskets and chimes hung from the eave for the tags; the departure half (east, toward the villages) has the wicker bench, wrapped bundles and urns. Three candle stands run across the floor between the halves. The keeper's hut (HTBM bamboohut02, linked cell) stands east on the villages' side, chimes on its eave.
The keeper house stands on stilts with no levelled pad.

2.9b-e8: node.somnalius-fern, a gatherable somnalius fern beside the plant-fern socket's wild fern in the damp shade by the handover shelter; the marsh's somnalius fern (fauna-hazards.md:98) grows back a frond in three days.

Skyrim.esm stands ImpDoorSingleLoad01 in ImpExtDoorhole01 at 7 placements: offset +0.46..0.64 m along the hood x axis, -0.10..-0.48 m down, relative yaw -90, scale 0.73-0.85 (median 0.84, e.g. ref 0001AB9D). The sealing party notice: plank boards nailed across the shut door inside the doorway hood, facing west down the hollow, so anyone coming down the stair reads it before the door. Scaled 0.93 so the planks bear on both hood jambs within the 0.05 m bite (propSeatRule: side contact with its shell) and lie on the leaf (gap 0.004 m).
Glow fungus grows in the damp either side of the sealed door and is kept off the doorway, so the door stands dark. It is the only light in the hollow.
impextblocks01, not blocks02: blocks02 has no plugin-measured sink (its Skyrim.esm refs all stand on other statics), blocks01 does.
Nordic wall vines hang on the vault face either side of the doorway hood, back on the face plane (x 1736.0), rooted below the hollow floor: the face has stood exposed since the dig (worn).
Spoil from the dig, dumped on the hollow's north and south rims: dark heaps that wall the hollow, seen from the stair foot (threatening).
A second bone scatter at the stair foot, from the lair-bone-scatter set: whoever came down first got no further (threatening).
A third glow fungus on the north side of the door: the hollow's only light is this sickly green at the door (wrong light, lair rule).
The curtain carries on one broken length south of k-1 toward the road (its broken end the stub): from the west road it screens the court, so the court is first seen through the gate.
Moved 1.0 m north of its copied pose, off the toe of the fallen curtain bank (m-bank), so it still lies on the lake flat.
A torn leg lies by the rags, where it was dragged to the door.
Moved 2.9 m off the door so the doorway stays dark. The fungus lights the hollow floor on either side.
Bloodied rags lie at the foot of the sealed door, beside the walk line. A creature from below has dragged its kills to the door.
node.rootland-mushroom (gather): rootland mushrooms come up in the wet shade under the moss-hung trees by the vault mouth (plant-1); a forager cuts the cap and the stalk grows another.

node.swamp-fungal-pod (gather): fungal pods swell on the open damp ground at the foot of the spoil bank, a few steps from the glowing mushrooms, where a forager coming down to the vault mouth sees them; picked pods regrow in a few days.
the Legion stage: one Imperial shell (farmhouse01, thatch on plaster and rubble), door east onto the coast track; secondaryCultures imperial (0117 change set d6178109)
the net loft: a plank store west of the yard wall where the dry nets and rope are kept off the wet ground
the smokehouse: a second old stable, open on one side, by the track where the catch hangs in the smoke of a slow fire
the third household: a thatched plank house east of the home path, the newest of the salvage families
each household works two spots. The sorting pile of barrels, crates and sacks stands by the door. The net-mending corner at the back holds the catch rack, the nets and the plank offcuts.

walk 12: the owner saw nothing of wreck salvage; a salvaged ship's plank in the yard and a ship's anchor for sale by the stall show the trade (the Skyrim shipwreck boards are water-class and refuse dry ground)

The stage ends on the firm bank a step short of the pier foot. Both of its ends rest on ground, so no rope hangs over a join. The one mined dock corner would turn the stage south or east into the water, away from the Lilmoth track.

2.11 TG04: the speaker's crate holding the hull tally. Ferries.esp stands this small cargo crate on a ferry deck (cratesmall02 on rowboat_ferry_solstheim_011, ref 040008A7); no plugin loads river_ferry_rift_01, so it is deck-mounted on h-n02's flat aft deck.

Walk 12: the owner saw the two porticos as free-standing doors into nothing. Each now stands at the foot of a hill that climbs from the path (m-a-hill-w, m-a-hill-e, ramp profile, soft blend) and closes on the portico's back over its lintel (m-d-back-w, m-d-back-e); a forecourt is dug to the sill with sloped sides (m-b-cut-w, m-b-cut-e) and a ramp leads down into it from the path (m-c-ramp-w, m-c-ramp-e). Part 3: mound uids carry a/b/c/d because overlays apply in id order (hill, cut, ramp, back). The scrubbing scaffolds are gone (owner, walk 12): each portico is itself the parcel's host, a door-only shell carrying the plugin load door into the temple.
Walk 12 close-out: the east portico's north side faces the street with no bank behind it; a bank rock closes that side so the door reads as cut into the hill.

Walk 12: the owner saw no row of teeth. The row is drawn 4 to 6 m nearer the bank, every tooth in knee-deep water, at 1.35 to 1.65 times the mined scale, each turned differently, so the six teeth read as a weathered colonnade from the landing rather than a set of identical posts (close-out).

Walk 12 close-out: two bank rocks flank the west portico so its door reads as cut into the rock of the hill; the hill ramps start 2 to 3 m behind the forecourt so its sides are low banks, not pit walls.

The Teeth of Sithis: six black xanmeer teeth standing in knee-deep water off the bank, the pilgrim way running out at the water opposite the gap between the middle pair. Two doors in the rock of the bank lead down into the temple below.
2.4g2: the bank rock settled into the raised hill 1.4 to 1.8 m deep (rockSeatRule); it is lifted to its seat on its three lowest contacts so it reads as lying on the bank.
2.5x seats: the Clutch's three outdoor keepers eat at midday where the pilgrim way meets the water; two plain benches flank the way, 4 m off its line on level bank, facing the teeth.
2.5x seats: the east bench of the pair at the way's end, within reach of the priest, the scrubber and the temple keeper's door.
